theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (f : X → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (A : Set X), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable ψ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (μH[(m : ℝ)] : Measure X) (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ ψ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ψ t ≤ 2 * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * (μH[((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)] : Measure X) A
